# frameact

> frameact is a fine-grained signals UI framework (SolidJS-style: no virtual DOM, components run once, only bindings update) with teact-style frame discipline: all reactive work and every DOM write is batched into one requestAnimationFrame pass with measure, mutate and forced-reflow phases. Built for messenger-class clients (long lists, high-frequency store updates, heavy animations). TypeScript, MIT, early development, not published to npm yet.

Notes for writing code with frameact:
- Components are plain functions that run once. Props are reactive getters: never destructure them, read `props.x` where it is used.
- JSX is compiled by the Solid 2.0 compiler pointed at `frameact/dom` (Vite plugin `frameact/vite`; `jsx: "preserve"`, `jsxImportSource: "frameact"`). Client-side DOM only, no SSR.
- Effects are two-phase: `createEffect(compute, apply, schedule?)`; `compute` is tracked and pure, `apply` does the side effect. The facade picks the phase: `createMeasureEffect` reads layout, `createMutationEffect` writes the DOM.
- Controlled inputs use `use:value` / `use:checked`, not `value=`. Lists use `<For>`, conditionals `<Show>` / `<Switch>`.
- State: `frameact/store` is a signal-tree store written in place with a path API (`setState('chats', id, 'title', t)`), `reconcile`, `produce`, `defineActions`.
- Never feed untrusted content into `<Dynamic component>`, spread bags, `innerHTML=` or `prop:*`.
- The API list in `docs/llms-full.md` is checked against the source; prefer it over memory of Solid, React or teact APIs.

## Docs

- [API guide for writing apps (self-contained)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/docs/llms-full.md): setup, signals and effects, phases, control flow, elements and controlled inputs, store, heavy animations, stricterdom, kit, common mistakes
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/README.md): what frameact is, how a frame works, security notes, store and stricterdom overview
- [Porting a teact / telegram-tt client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/docs/guides/porting-from-teact.md): hooks to primitives table, traps, store model, scroll anchoring
- [Design spec (Russian)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-11-frameact-design.md): architecture and decisions behind every module
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/AGENTS.md): for AI agents contributing to the framework itself (invariants, conventions, licensing)

## Entry points (source)

- [frameact](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/src/index.ts): signals, memos, effects, context, frame and heavy-animation API, lifecycle primitives
- [frameact/dom](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/src/dom/index.ts): render, For, Show, Switch, Dynamic, Portal, mergeProps, class and style helpers
- [frameact/store](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/src/store/index.ts): createStore, merge, produce, reconcile, defineActions
- [frameact/kit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/src/kit/index.ts): Transition, ShowTransition, InfiniteScroll, createScrollAnchor
- [frameact/stricterdom](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/src/stricterdom/index.ts): DEV phase-violation checks with effect attribution
- [frameact/scheduler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/src/scheduler/index.ts): requestMeasure, requestMutation, debounce, throttle
- [frameact/vite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/src/vite/index.ts): the Vite plugin

## Optional

- [Core benchmark notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/denislibs/frameact/main/bench/reactivity/README.md): reactive-graph results against Solid, Preact Signals, Alien Signals (Russian)
